#### Manage your subscription

# Cancel your subscription

These steps apply to subscriptions billed directly on the web. Apple-billed subscriptions must be canceled separately through Apple, see [Apple-billed subscriptions](#apple-billed-subscriptions) below.

## Before you cancel

Combining accounts is permanent. Canceling **The X Subscription** does not separate those accounts or restore your previous Cursor, SuperGrok, or X Premium subscriptions.

## Cancel a direct-billed plan

1. Go to **Billing & invoices** on your [grok.com dashboard](https://grok.com/dashboard).
2. Open the options on your current plan and follow the prompts to cancel.

You can cancel at any time.

## Cancel a seat

On Team plans, a canceled seat stays active until the end of the billing period. Reassigning it before then keeps it active. While the whole plan is set to cancel, you can’t add members.

## Cancel on X

If you subscribed to The X Subscription on X, cancel it in X.

## Cancel in Google Play

If you subscribed through Google Play, cancel it in the Google Play Store.

## Apple-billed subscriptions

If you have a separate Apple-billed Cursor subscription, cancel it through Apple. Canceling The X Subscription does not cancel that Apple-billed subscription.
